system.description:
Less about the one perfect tool, more about the shelf of forty imperfect ones. Something in the bag always does the job.

  • Brew Formula (1st): During downtime, brew potions, bombs, and elixirs from your known formula list, each formula costs 1 Ingenuity Point to brew (2 for a damaging one) and persists until used. You can hold brewed formulas equal to your Intelligence modifier + your Artificer level; extras go inert.
  • Efficient Brewing (3rd): Formulas cost 1 less Ingenuity Point to brew (minimum 1).
  • Combat Alchemy (7th): Once per encounter, brew a single formula on the spot as an action at double the normal Ingenuity cost.
  • Volatile Mastery (11th): Your bombs and harmful formulas deal an additional die of damage, and increase the DC of the triggered save by 1.
  • Lasting Work: Perfected Formula (15th): Once per week, spend a full day and appropriate materials to perfect one formula into a permanent-effect item (a ring that continuously radiates Draught of Clarity's protection, a self-refilling flask of Elixir of Vigour, or a blade permanently coated with Caustic Flask's acid) rather than a consumable.
  • Magnum Opus: The Panacea (24th): Brew a single legendary elixir capable of curing any one affliction, condition, or injury when drunk — including things no ordinary Restoration-tier magic touches. One dose only, ever, per Artificer. Requires a month of uninterrupted work and rare materials the GM determines.

Known Formulas

  • Fire Bomb — Thrown — 2d6 fire damage, plus 1d6 per five Artificer levels, in a 10ft radius, Reflex save for half
  • Elixir of Vigour — Drink to gain temporary HP equal to 1d8 + Intelligence modifier
  • Caustic Flask — Thrown — target saves or takes 1d6 acid damage per round for 3 rounds
  • Draught of Clarity — Drink for Advantage on your next saving throw vs a mind-affecting effect within 1 hour
  • Smoke Powder Bomb — Thrown — creates a 15ft radius obscuring cloud
  • Sovereign Glue — Bonds two objects together permanently, or until dissolved by a specific solvent
  • Universal Solvent — A few drops dissolve any adhesive on contact, including your own Sovereign Glue
  • Draught of Steady Hands — Drink for Advantage on your next Dexterity-based check within 1 hour
  • Numbing Salve — Applied to a wound — the recipient ignores the effects of 1 point of exhaustion for 1 hour
  • Choking Gas Vial — Thrown — 10ft radius, creatures save or are unable to speak or cast verbal spells for 1 round
  • Quickfoam — Thrown at a fire or flammable area — extinguishes flames in a 10ft radius instantly
  • Reagent of Revealing — A few drops on a surface reveal invisible writing, residue, or a recently-handled object's last handler (GM discretion)

Designing a Custom Formula

  • Benchmark: A thrown or drunk formula should land at roughly a 1st-level spell's potency — 2d6 damage in a small area, a single round of a save-or-suffer condition, or a flat, narrow buff (Advantage on one specific roll type, or temporary HP equal to a small die plus Intelligence modifier). Formulas that grant information or utility (detection, identification, minor restoration) should require a genuine cost — a rare ingredient, a full round to apply, or a limited number of uses — rather than being free and repeatable.
